# Conformance vectors of the mediated-connection channel, version 1.
# One vector per line: NAME <TAB> HEX <TAB> EXPECTED. Whitespace inside the
# hex is for reading; "-" is the empty datagram. Regenerate nothing by hand:
# tests/test_channel.c replays every line against the codec, and a client
# that claims conformance replays the same lines. Contract:
# proposals/egress-channel-v1.md until v1 freezes.
# EXPECTED: 'OK HOST PORT', 'MALFORMED' or 'UNSUPPORTED'; an OK vector also round-trips through the encoder.
valid-example	4d454351 01 01 01bb 000b 6578616d706c652e636f6d	OK example.com 443
valid-min-host	4d454351 01 01 0001 0001 61	OK a 1

empty-datagram	-	MALFORMED
